columns.desc: QTable column definitions, plus the QGrid extras: filter_type ('text' | 'select' | 'date' | 'number_range'), date_format, show_filter, grouping, aggregate, editable, filter_options

row_key.desc: Property of each row that defines the unique key of each row

visible_columns.desc: Names of the columns to display (columns with 'required: true' are always shown); supports v-model:visible_columns

pagination.desc: Pagination object (sortBy, descending, page, rowsPerPage); supports v-model:pagination

ssr_pagination.desc: Server-side pagination: the parent owns 'pagination' and answers @OnRequest

global_filter.desc: External global filter term (overrides the built-in search input)

columns_filter_toggle.desc: Show a button that toggles the filter row

filter_input_props.desc: Props forwarded to every filter input (e.g. { outlined: true, color: 'primary' })

filter_debounce.desc: Debounce (ms) of the text filter inputs

header_filter.desc: Enable the header value-filter menus (on columns with 'show_filter: true')

clear_filters.desc: Show a 'Clear filters' button while any filter is active

server_side_filters.desc: Do not filter on the client; column filter changes trigger @OnRequest with a 'filters' model

groupby_filter.desc: Show the 'Group By' selector (columns with 'grouping: true')

draggable.desc: Drag & drop rows (reorders 'data' in place, emits @dragged_row)

ignore_rows.desc: Indexes (in the filtered data) of rows that cannot be dragged or dropped on

ignore_cols.desc: Indexes of columns that cannot be dragged or dropped on

csv_download.desc: Show the CSV export button (exports the filtered, sorted, visible data)

excel_download.desc: Show the Excel export button (real .xlsx, no dependency)

virtual_scroll.desc: Render only the visible rows (use together with 'height'); disables row drag & drop

height.desc: Fixed table height, e.g. '480px' (needed by virtual scroll / sticky header)

sticky_header.desc: Keep the header (and filter row) visible while scrolling

state_key.desc: Persist filters, sort, column order/visibility and grouping in localStorage under this key

dark.desc: Notify the component that the background is a dark color

bordered.desc: Applies a default border to the component

square.desc: Removes border-radius so borders are squared

labels.desc: Override any UI string (i18n), e.g. { search: 'Suche', selectAll: 'Alle' }

icons.desc: Override any built-in icon (any QIcon name)

body.desc: Custom row; receives the full QTable row scope (row, cols, key, selected, expand...)

header.desc: Custom header row; receives the full QTable header scope

body-cell-[name].desc: Custom cell for column [name] while keeping the default row (scope: row, col, value)

header-cell-[name].desc: Custom header cell content for column [name] (scope: col, cols, sort)

detail.desc: Master/detail: content of an expandable row under each row (scope: row, cols)

top_right.desc: Replace the top-right toolbar (scope: exportTable, toggleFullscreen, clear_filters, ...)

[any QTable slot].desc: top-left, no-data, pagination, bottom, top-row, bottom-row... are forwarded to QTable

FilteredData.desc: Rows left after the QGrid filters (group rows when grouped)

OnRequest.desc: QTable @request plus the column filter model

exportTable.desc: Export the filtered, sorted, visible data

clearFilters.desc: Reset every column/header filter and the global search

getFilterModel.desc: Serializable description of the active filters

getState.desc: Serializable grid state (filters, sort, column order/visibility, grouping)

setState.desc: Apply a state previously returned by getState()

resetState.desc: Back to defaults (and forget the persisted state)

setGroupBy.desc: Group by a column field ('' to ungroup)
